name: Grupo Solverde (Solverde - Sociedade de Investimentos Turisticos da Costa Verde)
note: Portuguese casino and hotel group, founded on 12 April 1972 by Manuel de Oliveira Violas. Wholly held by Violas SGPS, the family holding controlled in equal parts by the siblings Manuel and Rita Celeste (ECO, 28 January 2026). Runs online games and betting at solverde.pt under SRIJ licences 10 and 24.
